title: Bishkek State University Enters the UI GreenMetric World University Rankings 2025

blocks.text: In December 2025, Bishkek State University was included in the UI GreenMetric World University Rankings, placing 1,740th worldwide and 7th among higher education institutions of the Kyrgyz Republic.

Participation in the UI GreenMetric ranking confirms the University’s commitment to the principles of sustainable development, environmental responsibility, and the integration of green technologies into its academic, research, and administrative activities.

This achievement is the result of systematic efforts aimed at developing environmentally friendly infrastructure, improving energy efficiency, ensuring responsible resource management, and fostering environmental awareness among students and staff.

The implementation of these projects promotes the integration of modern environmental standards, digital solutions, and innovative management approaches, strengthening the University’s position in the international academic community. Bishkek State University will continue its consistent efforts to implement sustainable development principles and expand international cooperation in the field of green technologies.
